title: with a pointer brief the ## Fields block comes after the target text and before the JITSO rules
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, Pre-release fixes (the fields reach brief.md)
intent: The brief file is a pointer, so the text of the target takes the place of the brief. The `## Fields` block follows that target text and the rules stay last; the `Brief:` line is nowhere in the file.

regex:
Read the sync entry point of this project(?s:.*)

## Fields
- env: qa
- ticket_key: BK-7

## JITSO rules
Start other agent sessions only with the card's `launch:` line\.
Load the card's skills before any other work\. You may ask the human\.
Leave `jitso/`, `\.jitso/` and `~/\.jitso/` alone except your own draft in `\.jitso/drafts/`, and never run `jitso build save`\.
$
